intended_object: The linear functional εᵢ − εⱼ on the diagonal Cartan subalgebra of the split even orthogonal Lie algebra so(2n) (type D_n). Here εᵢ is the i-th coordinate functional. Inferred from the docstring and from the module, which computes the root spaces of type D.
explanation:
The definition is `typeDEpsilon i - typeDEpsilon j`. `typeDEpsilon i` is the i-th element of the dual basis of the coordinate basis of the diagonal Cartan. By `typeDEpsilon_apply`, it sends a diagonal element A to its entry A_{(inl i),(inl i)}. That is exactly the standard εᵢ for the hyperbolic-basis model of so(2n). So `typeDWeightSub i j` sends A to A_{ii} − A_{jj}, which is the textbook weight εᵢ − εⱼ (Bourbaki Plate IV; Humphreys §12).

Degenerate case: when i = j the definition gives the zero functional, which is the right value of εᵢ − εᵢ. Whether i ≠ j is required for it to be a root is a separate question, handled elsewhere in the library.

Generality: the definition works over any commutative ring and any finite index type with decidable equality. That is the natural setting for the split type-D Lie algebra as it is built in Mathlib (`LieAlgebra.Orthogonal.typeD`). Mathlib has no ready-made type-D weight functional.
